'''Telsin-Fal''' was a [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Posted at the [[Koss Overlook]] in the [[Gormak Lands]], he asked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] to destroy the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] [[Gormegan-1]].
